findings.rationale: provider_job_id assertion now runs against three backends that never set it
findings.explanation: Trimming the adapter list from this guard changes which backends reach the body below it. Two of the remaining three populate provider_job_id lazily, so the assertion can observe nil before the enqueue round-trip settles.

findings.rationale: delayed_job block inherits a jobs_manager teardown that no longer runs
findings.explanation: Three tests that called jobs_manager.stop_workers were deleted just above, and that manager was what restored worker state between cases. The block starting here reuses the same manager without an equivalent reset.
